description: List the OAuth scopes of Tiendanube / Nuvemshop apps and the resources each one opens, or find the scope for a resource, endpoint path or scope name. Use it when choosing the scopes of an app in the Partners Portal or debugging a 401/403.

query.description: A scope ("write_fulfillment_orders"), a resource ("Draft Order") or a path ("/orders/{id}"). Empty lists every scope.

name: lookup-scope
title: Look up OAuth scopes
